title: TacZ: Modern Warfare
description: Enjoy the TaCZ experience on playable Call of Duty maps!
body:
**A Timeless And Classic Zero (TaCZ) modpack, with more than 11 official Call Of Duty maps, ideal for playing with friends or quick matches with bots!**

## Disclaimer

All the maps included here were created by [Qiuye_](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/qiuye_/) and [Cube Horizon](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/cube_horizon/); consider following them on PlanetMinecraft!

## FaQ

A: __"Can I play on servers?"__

Yes, but the server will need to have all these mods.

A: __"How do I play with friends?"__

Just open the world to LAN and a link will appear in a few seconds. Your friends will enter that link in Multiplayer > Direct Connection. (Note: Everyone will disconnect each time you leave, as a different link is used each time.)

A: __"Can I play in Singleplayer mode?"__

Yes! This modpack includes the Simple Enemy Mod, so simply activating the lever found on every map will cause enemies to spawn every few seconds!
